decisionRationale: The supported Node 24 LTS line covers the planned study and publication period.
The exact patch version already passed the complete Memos and Excalidraw five-tool acceptance suites.
Freezing an exact patch version prevents silent runtime drift during correctness revalidation and later measurements.
Older Node 22 correctness cells must pass again on this runtime before confirmatory measurements begin.
changeControl: Any runtime or patch-version change requires a new policy version and complete correctness revalidation before further publication-eligible measurements.
